scope: Read-only narrow contract and early source review; no device, no REA, no tests executed. Author source may still change.
accepted: Independent new holder/start and 1800-second budget; immutable origin apply-plan/admission and origin boot backup names.
All five backups and ABSENT marker required before mutation, exact source pins, six-state known-before/known-after checks and per-target CAS.
Original T30 executor remains unchanged; successor is rollback-only and rejects physical-only recovery.
pending: Actual fake-transport execution of the successor, not only policy unit assertions.
Apply WID29 drift rejection and recovery numeric-only WID normalization must be stated separately.
Recovery origin must be the apply transaction actually retained, not the previously rolled-back T30 transaction.
Live parent/host required; dead identity recovery is not supported by this successor.
Partial recovery after run.sh changes back to WID29 while current WMS/parent still use another WID is fail-closed on retry. Exercise this exact cut-point or explicitly narrow support.
suggested_minimal_cases: All 64 combinations of five file before/after and compat absent/after, with all backups intact.
Each foreign artifact; missing each backup/ABSENT marker; wrong metadata/label; physical/private inode mismatch; altered plan/admission/source pin.
Old holder/start reuse, expired new start, current lock drift, boot/PID/birth/UID/namespace/WMS drift.
Apply WID41 rejected; recovery WID41 accepted only if raw run and environment/WMS match and normalized bytes equal an exact original template.
Failure after run replacement but before compat removal, then retry with unchanged live WID41: retain refusal explicitly, do not claim full arbitrary partial-state retry.
Changed backup after pre-read, foreign target before rename, wrong compat before unlink: generated shell retains adjacent CAS and no success receipt.
